text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely win it! For the sake of the Trainer
who guided me all the way here!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
To answer everyone's feelings!
Taaaaaaaahhh!!

Victory was right before her eyes! ...Or so it seemed.
However—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Admire! It's Admire!
Admire Vegaa--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
On the grand stage of the Nippon Derby,
she has become a brilliant first-magnitude star!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

Narita Top Road was no match for a late spurt
that seemed as if it were carving away at their very own flesh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I gave it everything I had...
I wanted to run my absolute best race. But...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Everyone cheered for me so much... And Trainer believed in me, too...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: U-U-Uuuu...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaaahn!
Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaahn!!

Unrestrained wailing echoed out
across the vivid green turf...

From the tips of her hair to the soles of her feet—
those were true tears that only one who had burned
through everything could shed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer...-san...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I'm so...

I stood beside Narita Top Road for a long time
until her feelings finally settled down.

All I can do... is say nothing
and simply stay by their side.
And so, with both the Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby) over, the two great spring battles came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, Opera O-chan,
great work out there!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um, there's something
I really need to tell you both.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What is it, Top Road-san?
So formal all of a sudden...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: This spring—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the match!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: There were so many happy moments, and so many frustrating ones too! But—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thanks to having the two of you with me, I was able to run a truly wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It was fun, very much so.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It was... fun...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's too early to thank me.
Because...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What is it that we are aiming for?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: What we... are aiming for?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, what we strive for is to become the fastest Umamusume,
or the luckiest Umamusume...
Surely it doesn't just end there, does it?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's right, the "strongest" Umamusume!
More than anything, isn't that the title you want?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And the race where the strongest Umamusume
is said to claim victory is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The autumn 'Kikuka Sho'!
The race that concludes the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho...
Indeed. The finish line of the Classic road.
A long-distance 3,000m race...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, unless we traverse that thorny path,
our first act won't be over."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let's meet again in the fall—my friend!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes, Opera O-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It was... fun...?
Racing is... fun...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing.
Nothing at all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
There were things I did well and things I didn't,
so a lot happened, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: But... in my own way...

I gently caught her collapsing body.
She had burned completely bright and exhausted every ounce of her strength.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much...
Thank you...
Even with her strength spent, who are those words overflowing from her meant for? But...

"I decided to let her rest for a little while.
A brief respite. And beyond that—"

The autumn 'Kikuka Sho' awaits.
The grand finale of the Classic Triple Crown.
